create_digraph_directive: create a reStructuredText directive that renders a directed graph from DOT source as SVG
create_strict_digraph_directive: create a reStructuredText directive that renders a strict directed graph from DOT source as SVG
create_graph_directive: create a reStructuredText directive that renders an undirected graph from DOT source as SVG
create_strict_graph_directive: create a reStructuredText directive that renders a strict undirected graph from DOT source as SVG
register_mcss_dot_directives: register all DOT graph directives with Docutils and configure font settings for m.css
